mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 64 degrees at the Verona Area High School.

The City of Verona has announced that Highway M will be closed for road improvements from October 6 to October 9, and remember that early in-person voting for the November 3 election begins at City Hall on October 20.
There is plenty to do today with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga classes, and trivia night, plus Art Bar Happy Hour kicks off tomorrow.
In a report from September 21, a retail theft occurred at a business on East Verona Avenue where a subject was identified and cited for taking Swedish Fish.
Enjoy the delicious Double Strawberry flavor of the day at Culver's, where the store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
